# Auralis (`v0.4.0`)

> Calm, private local AI workspace for Apple Silicon: streamed Ollama chat, zero-dependency PDF extraction, hybrid BM25 knowledge base with line citations, loopback security, and local voice room.

- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/auralis-local/
- Memory & Context Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/auralis-local/studio.html
- Benchmark & Test Proof: https://codesphere-u.github.io/auralis-local/proof.html
- Loopback & Security Rules: https://codesphere-u.github.io/auralis-local/rules.html
- Documentation: https://codesphere-u.github.io/auralis-local/docs.html
